basic_details.job_title: SECL Full Time Advisor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: South Eastern Coalfields Limited (SECL), a subsidiary of Coal India Limited, is engaging one Full Time Advisor at Dankuni Coal Complex (DCC) for six months to speed up the mutation of DCC land. The post is open to retired executives (retired Below Board Level Officers) and the officers and members named in the notice. Candidates must be graduates with 5 years' land acquisition/R&R experience and aged more than 60 years but not more than 65 years during the contract period. how_to_apply: Download the Application Form from the SECL website www.secl-cil.in under the caption "Career" (the application format is also printed on page 4 of the notice).
Fill in and sign the application format and affix a self-attested photo.
Attach your resume and the self-attested documents listed below.

Send the application by Registered Post/Speed Post to: Office of The General Manager (HR/EE), Executive Establishment Department, South Eastern Coalfields Limited, Seepat Road, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, Pin: 495006.
Make sure it reaches by 25.11.2026, 5:00 PM.
Documentary proof of the claimed experience
Details of work Experience and promotion
Certificate of Scale of Pay (in case of Non-CIL retired executive)

The application format asks for the notification reference and date, personal and contact details, caste, date of superannuation, qualification, experience, employment details till superannuation (organisation, post, grade, pay scale, basic pay, discipline, period), special achievements, any departmental/vigilance or court case, the superannuation notice number and date, and a list of enclosures.
important_instructions: Applications received after 25.11.2026, 5:00 PM shall not be considered; SECL is not responsible for any postal delay or loss in transit. Incomplete applications, or applications without the documents named in the notice, shall not be considered. Only complete applications received in hard copy within the time limit will be considered. SECL reserves the right to change the number of vacancies and cancel/restrict/modify/alter the engagement process without further notice. Any modification or amendment will be given on the SECL website only. Correspondence will be made at the address/email ID given in the application; important information will also be on the SECL website. The decision of SECL Management will be final and binding.
For queries, the notice's letterhead gives the email ID [email protected] and phone number 07752 - 246336.

content_sections.heading: About SECL
content_sections.text: South Eastern Coalfields Limited is a Government of India Undertaking and a Mini Ratna company, a subsidiary of Coal India Limited, with its registered office at Seepat Road, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh. This engagement is issued by its Executive Establishment Department under CIL's Policy for availing the services of retired CMDs/Directors/Senior Level Executives as full-time/part-time Advisors, as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites the following kinds of applicants: Retired executives (retired Below Board Level Officers) from CIL & its subsidiaries/PSUs/autonomous organizations of Central/State governments. Officers of class-C and above of Central & State Govt. (Non-clerical). Members of National Level professional institution. Retired employees who have opted for Voluntary Retirement (VRS) shall not be eligible for consideration. The 5 years' experience in Land acquisition/R&R must have been gained while serving in PSUs/autonomous organizations of Central/State governments, as officers of class-C and above of Central & State Govt. (Non-clerical) & members of National Level professional institution. Documentary proof of the claimed experience must be enclosed. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full wording of each eligibility condition.

rows.requirement: Graduate in any discipline from recognized University/ Institute.
05 (Five) years' experience in Land acquisition/R&R (details below).
Knowledge in land mutation/revenue related works in Hooghly District, West Bengal.
More than 60 years but not more than 65 years during the contract period.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Advisor gets a consolidated monthly compensation/honorarium based on the grade from which the executive retired: Accommodation: Suitable Company's accommodation shall be provided on availability. If it is not available, a consolidated amount will be paid as per the applicable CIL HRA rules for X, Y and Z class of cities based on the DoE OM dated 07.07.2017. If Company's accommodation is given, house rent as applicable to Executives on roll will be recovered. Conveyance: The Company shall provide conveyance as per availability; where it is not provided, the Advisor is eligible for 5% of consolidated pay per month as conveyance charges. Mobile phone: Reimbursement based on the actual bills or Rs. 1000/- p.m., whichever is less. Medical, leave and TA/DA: As per CIL's Policy for availing the services of Advisors. GST: If payment of GST is required, it shall be reimbursed on production of proof of payment. The engagement is on a fixed tenure basis for Six (06) Months. Either side may end the contract with one month's notice or consolidated honorarium. The engagement is subject to medical fitness certified by the Company Medical Officer, and other terms follow CIL's Policy in vogue.

content_sections.heading: SECL FULL TIME ADVISOR at DCC Job Description
content_sections.text: The Advisor's role is to expedite mutation of DCC land acquired through 09 Nos. of notifications under the West Bengal Land Requisition and Acquisition Act, 1948. The work will broadly include: Supervising the job of mutation/updating of RoR/updating the nature of the acquired land of DCC in favour of the project. Pursuing with the State Govt of West Bengal regarding expediting mutation of land of DCC acquired in 09 Nos. of notifications. Liaising with the Govt of West Bengal for arranging necessary documents for the job. Any other jobs assigned as per the requirement of DCC and SECL. The selected Advisor would be stationed at DCC or as per the requirement of the Company, must maintain the integrity and secrecy of the Company's business, must not engage in any other business during the tenure, and must devote whole time to the company.

Send the application by Registered Post/Speed Post to: Office of The General Manager (HR/EE), Executive Establishment Department, South Eastern Coalfields Limited, Seepat Road, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, Pin: 495006. No TA/DA will be paid to any candidate for appearing in the interview/selection process. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the SECL Full Time Advisor at DCC recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) post of Full Time Advisor at Dankuni Coal Complex (DCC).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the SECL Advisor post?
faq.answer: The application must reach SECL, Bilaspur by 25 November 2026, 5:00 PM; later applications shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the SECL Full Time Advisor post?
faq.answer: Graduate in any discipline from recognized University/ Institute, with 05 (Five) years' experience in Land acquisition/R&R.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the SECL Advisor post?
faq.answer: Applicants should be more than 60 years but not more than 65 years during the contract period.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the SECL Full Time Advisor?
faq.answer: The consolidated honorarium ranges from Rs. 50,000/- p.m. for a retired E-2 grade executive to Rs. 1,50,000/- p.m. for a retired E-9 grade executive.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the SECL Advisor post at DCC?
faq.answer: Send the filled and signed application format with your resume and self-attested documents by Registered Post/Speed Post to the Office of The General Manager (HR/EE), Executive Establishment Department, South Eastern Coalfields Limited, Seepat Road, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, Pin: 495006.

faq.question: Q7. How will the SECL Advisor be selected?
faq.answer: SECL may shortlist candidates for interview, and selection will be done on the basis of performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the SECL Advisor post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is an engagement on a fixed tenure basis for Six (06) Months, with one month's notice or consolidated honorarium from either side for termination.

faq.question: Q9. Can employees who took Voluntary Retirement apply?
faq.answer: No, retired employees who have opted for Voluntary Retirement (VRS) shall not be eligible for consideration.

faq.question: Q10. Does the SECL Advisor get accommodation or HRA?
faq.answer: Company's accommodation is provided on availability; if it is not available, a consolidated amount is paid as per the applicable CIL HRA rules for X, Y and Z class of cities.
